name: Nuwa
subtitle: Creator of Mankind
description: Nuwa is a formidable support hero who can protect her allies with powerful barriers and heal them. She can also deal damage to enemies and remove their buffs.
lore: Born from the fragments of the universe, Nuwa is a primordial deity, a being of immense cosmic power and serene wisdom. In the dawn of creation, when chaos reigned and the very fabric of existence was yet unformed, Nuwa emerged, a gentle force amidst the maelstrom. She is the mother of all creation, believed to have molded humanity from clay, breathing life into them with her divine breath. Her presence brought order to the nascent world, shaping mountains, rivers, and stars with her ethereal hands. As a guardian of balance, Nuwa intervenes when the cosmos teeters on the brink of destruction, her compassion limitless, her power absolute. She is the embodiment of patience and creativity, forever weaving the tapestry of existence, ensuring harmony prevails in the grand cosmic symphony.
divinity_generator: Nuwa generates 10 Divinity at the start of each of her turns and 1 Divinity whenever an ally takes damage.

skills.name: Serpent's Curse
skills.description: Applies [mechanic:atk-down-ii] for 2 turns and deals 180%ATK magic damage to all enemies. Has a 70% chance to apply.
skills.awakening_bonus: Increases chance to apply ATK Down by 20%.

skills.name: Dragon's Breath
skills.description: Deals 260%ATK magic damage to a single enemy.

skills.name: Dragon's Fury
skills.description: Summons a Dragon Spirit to deal 320%ATK magic damage to all enemies. Applies [mechanic:def-down-ii] for 2 turns to all enemies.

skills.name: Empowered Curses
skills.description: Increases the chance of applying debuffs by 20% on all skills.

skills.name: Life Weave
skills.description: Deals 100%ATK damage to an enemy and grants a [mechanic:barrier] to the ally with the lowest HP for 2 turns. The [mechanic:barrier] absorbs damage equal to 10% of Nuwa's Max HP.

skills.name: World Mender
skills.description: Restores HP to all allies equal to 20% of Nuwa's Max HP and grants them a [mechanic:barrier] for 2 turns. The [mechanic:barrier] absorbs damage equal to 15% of Nuwa's Max HP.

skills.name: Cosmic Genesis
skills.description: Deals 260%ATK damage to all enemies, removes all their buffs, and grants all allies a [mechanic:barrier] for 3 turns. The [mechanic:barrier] absorbs damage equal to 20% of Nuwa's Max HP.

skills.name: Primordial Essence
skills.description: At the start of combat, Nuwa gains a [mechanic:barrier] equal to 30% of her Max HP for 3 turns. Whenever an ally takes damage, Nuwa has a 25% chance to grant them a [mechanic:barrier] equal to 5% of her Max HP for 1 turn. This effect can only trigger once per turn.

skills.name: Serpent's Blessing
skills.description: Heals all allies for 15% of this unit's Max Health. Has a 100% chance to remove 1 random debuff from all allies. Grants all allies a Regeneration for 2 turns.

skills.name: All-Mother's Care
skills.description: When an ally takes damage, has a 25% chance to grant them a [mechanic:barrier] equal to 10% of this unit's Max Health for 2 turns.
skills.awakening_bonus: Chance and Shield amount are increased.

skills.name: Shield of the All-Mother
skills.description: Grants all allies a [mechanic:barrier] equal to 25% of this unit's Max Health for 2 turns. Has a 100% chance to grant 1 random ally a [mechanic:barrier] equal to 25% of this unit's Max Health for 2 turns if the target is already suffering from a [mechanic:barrier].

skills.name: Life Beam
skills.description: Deals 100% ATK damage to 1 enemy. If the target is suffering from Nuwa's Mark, has a 100% chance to grant all allies a Critical Rate Up II for 2 turns.

imprint_passive: Increases HP by 10% and restores 5% of max HP at the start of Nuwa's turn.
